title: Health and damage
description: Engine-independent health pools for players, enemies, destructible doors and structures. Damage passes through a custom modifier, respects a grace period, emits death once and supports explicit revival. Dead actors cannot heal. No DOM or three.js dependency.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.signature: attach(object, opts) → { update(dt), dispose(), damage(amount, source), heal(amount), revive(amount), value, max, dead, invulnerable }
exports.does: manages an actor health pool and timed damage immunity

options.name: invulnerability
options.does: seconds of immunity after accepted damage

hooks.name: modifyDamage
hooks.does: replace damage with armor, resistance or shields

hooks.name: onChange
hooks.does: react to damage, healing or revival

title: Atomic resource inventory
description: A weighted, capacity-limited resource bag. Submit positive and negative integer deltas in one atomic trade: either every cost and gain succeeds or nothing changes. Suitable for crafting, fuel, repairs, ammunition and trading. No engine dependency.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.signature: attach(object, opts) → { update(), dispose(), transact(delta), count(key), items, load, capacity }
exports.does: stores resource quantities; transact returns true only when the entire trade succeeds

options.name: weights
options.does: nonnegative per-item weight; unspecified items weigh one

hooks.name: onChange
hooks.does: react after a successful trade; arguments are copies

title: Proximity interaction
description: Select the nearest eligible target, show a focus prompt, and explicitly activate it with a cooldown. Rechecks eligibility on activation, so removed targets cannot remain usable. Works with 2D position.x/y and 3D position.x/z; inject distance for line-of-sight or other spaces.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.signature: attach(object, opts) → { update(dt), dispose(), interact(), focus }
exports.does: selects a nearby usable target and invokes a callback on explicit activation

options.name: targets
options.does: live target array; safe to add or remove targets

hooks.name: distance
hooks.does: replace spatial distance with another metric

hooks.name: canInteract
hooks.does: filter searched, locked, occluded or unusable targets

hooks.name: onFocus
hooks.does: show or hide prompts when focus changes

hooks.name: onInteract
hooks.does: search, repair, talk, open a door or activate an object

title: Phase cycle clock
description: Deterministic configurable phase timer for days and nights, rounds, waves and turn stages. Preserves elapsed-time overshoot and emits every crossed boundary in order. Finite runs complete once; invalid durations are rejected. Pausing is simply not calling update.
author: the internet slop warehouse

exports.name: attach
exports.does: advances a phase/cycle clock; state includes name, index, cycle, elapsed, remaining, progress and complete

options.name: phases
options.does: ordered phases with positive durations in seconds

options.name: cycles
options.does: number of full cycles before completion

hooks.name: onPhase
hooks.does: react after entering each new phase; initial phase is available in state

hooks.name: onCycle
hooks.does: react at the end of each full cycle

hooks.name: onComplete
hooks.does: react once at the end of a finite run

title: After the Siren
description: A moody top-down survival study: scavenge a deserted town in daylight, repair the refuge door, fuel a slowing ward and fight night visitors with a crowbar. Survive three 80-second day/night cycles. WASD/arrows move, Shift sprints, E searches/repairs/refuels, mouse aims, click or Space swings, F heals, Escape pauses. Includes touch controls, pause on blur, retry and victory. Procedural canvas art and synthesized sound; no external art assets. A foundation for deeper survival mechanics.
author: the internet slop warehouse
